signal-policy-v1.reason: 用户批准按冻结MT12规则明确发信号，置信度仅注释

execution.cost_status: exploratory all-in commission/tax/slippage scenario, not verified broker tariff
execution.fill: first later session open with explicit side-specific executable evidence and settlement eligibility; otherwise pending/unknown
execution.intrabar: daily OHLC cannot establish event ordering; close-only rule, intrabar breach diagnostic not a fill
execution.signal: completed_close; never same-bar fill or stop-price fill

group_B.candidate_set: same audited frozen scope; no discovery expansion

timing.industry: explicit market-matched benchmark + membership known_at required; unknown is not zero or veto
timing.promotion: candidate -> shadow -> validated -> active requires independent research signoff; development approval is not efficacy approval
timing.selection: one prespecified engineering baseline; no performance-based parameter choice or automatic promotion
